record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for jaw.stl: the beak hinge line is the x-axis through (y 0.0000, z 7.5000); bbox x -45.7079..45.7079, y -59.7105..9.0000, z -12.9477..16.5000 (91.4158 x 68.7105 x 29.4477 mm). Kept so the MJCF geom pos/quat (body jaw_soft) place it directly.
record.interfaces_live_at: the top-level `interfaces` key, per ce-parts/SCHEMA.md v2.4 (b) which cites `interfaces[0]`. The duplicate `record.interfaces` was removed 2026-09-02 (lane T) after `bin/triad check` FAILed the folder for carrying two spellings of one fact.

interfaces.name: mouth_horn
interfaces.what: the driven face of the beak: a Ø6.0000 x 4.1370 centre bore at (42.0680, 0.0000, 7.5000) with 4 x Ø2.2000 clearance holes (lengths 3.6950, 3.7600, 4.2590, 4.3240) on a Ø12.0034 bolt circle centred (42.0045, 0.0000, 7.5000) — the XL330 horn pattern (the servo's own taps are Ø1.6000 on Ø12.0000, measured on xl330.stl) — set in a Ø16.0000 x 2.7670 disc pocket at x 41.3840 that clears the servo's Ø16.0000 x 3.0010 output disc. Every fit residual on this pattern is 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg cover. Axis x through (y 0.0000, z 7.5000): the beak's hinge line.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's jaw.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and the mesh bbox, frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/jaw.json (lane T); the MJCF places this mesh in body 'jaw_soft' at world [26.1, -0.0, 231.1146] mm, quat (wxyz) [0.707107, 0.0, 0.0, 0.707107] (ce-assemblies/microduck/current/placements.json)

interfaces.name: bearing_journal
interfaces.what: the idler end of the same hinge line: a Ø10.0000 x 2.7000 journal (x -39.7000..-37.0000, fitted centre (0.0000, 7.5000) with residual <= 0.0025 mm at up to 359.91 deg cover) carrying the 15x10x3 bearing's INNER ring, behind a Ø11.9949 x 0.3000 shoulder flange at x -40.0000..-39.7000 and an axial Ø2.0000 x 7.0030 pin bore at x -40.5010. A Ø16.0000 x 2.7670 disc pocket at x -41.3840 mirrors the horn side. The bearing's OUTER ring is then held in part:microduck-motor-support 'lens_tube' — a Ø14.9938-14.9978 arch coaxial with THIS journal to 0.0005 mm (connection:press-fit-tube-15). Journal 2.7000 mm for a 3.0000 mm ring: 90.0% engagement, and which face the ring seats against is not stated in the reference.
